fields.description: Identifies one send surface - a screen or job that sends a WhatsApp message. Must be a key registered in SEND_SURFACES (pet_app/notifications/send_targets.py); an unregistered key is refused on save, because a settings row no surface reads is a default nobody can find.
fields.label: Surface Key

fields.description: Human name for this surface. Filled from the registry on save when left blank.
fields.label: Label

fields.description: Off behaves exactly as a blank default: the picker opens with nothing selected. Lets a default be switched off without losing which template it was.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: Blank means this surface has no configured default and its picker opens blank. There is no code-side fallback.
fields.label: Template Source

fields.description: The local template's template_key. Data, not a Link, so deleting a local template degrades this default to blank rather than blocking the delete.
fields.label: Template Key
